initialExam.title: SIDBI Grade A Officer 2026
initialExam.conductingBody: Small Industries Development Bank of India
initialExam.description: SIDBI recruits Grade A Officers for promoting, financing, and developing micro, small & medium enterprises across India.
initialExam.eligibility: Bachelor's Degree with 60% marks or CA/ICWA/CS
initialExam.syllabus: Phase I: English, Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning, General Awareness, MSME Sector. Phase II: Descriptive English, Domain Knowledge.
initialExam.examPattern: Phase I: 200 marks online. Phase II: 100 marks descriptive. Interview: 50 marks.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Phase I (Online) → Phase II (Descriptive) → Interview → Final Merit
initialExam.jobRole: Grade A Officer in SIDBI for MSME development and financing
initialExam.careerGrowth: Grade A → Grade B → DGM → GM → ED through promotions.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit sidbi.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, LFC, Pension (NPS), Housing Loan subsidy
